report.source_text: A pathology examination from the GEJ nodule showed squamous mucosa with mucosal ulcer and associated acute and chronic inflammatory infiltrates. Nests of atypical cohesive cells with clear cytoplasm, and mild nuclear pleomorphism were noted in submucosa. Multiple immunostains were performed to further characterize atypical cells with following staining pattern: vimentin (+), PAX-8 (+), CD10 (focally and weakly positive), and epithelial membrane antigen (EMA; focally and weakly positive) (Figs. 2, 3, 4, and 5). These cells were negative for RCC, thyroid transcription factor 1(TTF1), S100 protein, CD68, cytokeratin 5/6, pancytokeratin, p63, cytokeratin 7 and 20, p40, and pan melanoma marker. Histological features and staining patterns were consistent with atypical clear cell infiltrate involving squamous mucosa, which was consistent with metastatic RCC.

clinician.trajectory_summary: A 56-year-old Caucasian man with no significant past medical history presented with intermittent dysphagia to solids for several weeks, with sensation of food getting stuck in the substernal area. Physical examination was unremarkable with no palpable masses, lymphadenopathy, or organomegaly. Upper endoscopy (EGD) identified a 6 mm nodule at the gastroesophageal junction (GEJ) with associated Los Angeles grade A distal esophagitis. Biopsy of the GEJ nodule revealed squamous mucosa with mucosal ulceration and acute/chronic inflammatory infiltrates, with nests of atypical cohesive cells demonstrating clear cytoplasm and mild nuclear pleomorphism in the submucosa. Immunohistochemical staining showed vimentin (+), PAX-8 (+), CD10 (focally weakly +), and EMA (focally weakly +), with negative stains for RCC, TTF1, S100, CD68, cytokeratin 5/6, pancytokeratin, p63, cytokeratin 7/20, p40, and melanoma markers. A pathology conference concluded the histologic features and staining pattern were consistent with metastatic renal clear cell carcinoma (Fuhrman grade 2) involving esophageal mucosa with erosion. Concurrent imaging revealed a 5.8 × 5.3 cm solid, heterogenous, partially exophytic mass in the superior left kidney consistent with the primary renal clear cell carcinoma, with a small 0.6 cm benign-appearing gastrohepatic lymph node.
